findings.current: roasted alive like a whole pig
findings.defect: The translation invents a pig; the source says he thought he would be roasted whole while still alive.
findings.rationale: 산 채로 통구이가 되나 means being roasted whole alive and does not specify a pig.

findings.current: He had a point. I relaxed slightly at Jeok Cheongang’s helpful advice.
findings.defect: “Helpful advice” loses the deliberately modern, comic register of 꿀팁.
findings.rationale: 꿀팁 is colloquial slang for a useful “pro tip,” creating a joke by treating advice about avoiding defecation as practical expertise.
findings.replacement: He had a point. I relaxed slightly at Jeok Cheongang’s pro tip.

findings.current: The Fire King looked at me as though I were the craziest bastard he had ever seen and opened his mouth.
findings.defect: The superlative “craziest bastard he had ever seen” intensifies the source reaction.
findings.rationale: 별 미친놈 다 보겠다는 표정 expresses incredulous disbelief at encountering this particular lunatic, not a claim that he is the craziest ever encountered.
findings.replacement: The Fire King looked at me as if wondering what kind of lunatic I was and opened his mouth.

findings.current: I could tell the moment you opened your eyes.
findings.defect: The translation changes the evidence Jeok Cheongang cites: he says even the way the narrator opens his eyes is different, not merely that he recognized the change at that moment.
findings.rationale: 눈깔 뜨는 것부터가 다른데 refers to the manner of opening his eyes as visibly different, reinforcing Jeok Cheongang’s close observation.
findings.replacement: Even the way you open your eyes is different.

findings.defect: The line omits the regretful euphemistic force of 그만 after stating when Jin Baekyang died.
findings.rationale: 그만 conveys an unfortunate, regrettable outcome here; the accepted baseline preserved this pragmatic cue.
findings.replacement: “Just a couple of months ago, unfortunately…”

summary: The chapter is broadly faithful, with five minor defects involving an invented image, weakened joke register, intensified reaction, lost physical cue, and omitted pragmatic nuance.
